quests.title: A Garden Gathering

dialogue.t: Is this where you used to live? It's pretty.
It used to be even prettier. I have quite a knack for gardening, you know?
What are you laughing about now...
I was just picturing you crouching down, tending to the flowers. It's an adorable image.
Can I take a look inside?
Of course. I've already cleaned and dusted.
What are you going to do with the place?
Hmm... I think I still want to hold onto it. I can come back and tidy up whenever I have the time.
If you're busy, I can help take care of it for you.
It gives me the same feeling your old room used to. It's comforting... A happy place.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Alright, let's come back another time.

quests.description: Go to the hidden dwelling, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Columbina…
